independent_unit: Base network seed; six paired conditions per network, not 240 independent networks
primary: Both endpoints versus five nonendpoints in augmented_rank6; other conditions secondary
structural_controls: Rank-six augmentation adds four Gaussian modes at 0.5 relative Frobenius norm, then matches the original Frobenius norm. Independent random rank-six also matches it.
misspecification: Unmodelled rank-four connectivity at 10% Frobenius norm; unknown initial-state offset with SD 0.03. Separate conditions.
positive_gains: g=exp(theta-0.9^2/2), theta~N(0,0.9^2); correct model in fitting
metrics: mean raw response MSE within network
fit_audit: Report success and objective at generating latent parameters; any supplementary starts use a common rule for both policies and are reported separately.
sample_size: 40 fixed before validation outcomes; no outcome-adaptive stopping; no a-priori power guarantee
